Download **bambu-deck-0.1.2.streamDeckPlugin** and double-click it; Stream Deck installs the plugin along with its profiles.

- Setup guide: while no printer is set up, Bao explains the setup across the whole deck. Pick your printer family (X1, P1, P2S, A1, H2) and every key shows one step with the right menu for that model. Small decks page through with "Weiter"
- Setup guide: click any guide key in the Stream Deck app to enter the printer right there; a "Verbinde …" key shows the connection attempt, and the guide disappears once the printer answers
- Setup guide: "Demo" starts the simulated printers, "Später" closes the guide; pressing any "Einrichten" key brings it back
